purpose: Policy for automatic relay of validated commits and releases from Forgejo (SSOT) to GitHub (public projection).

target_pipeline.trigger: forgejo push webhook on main or release tag

preflight_gates.check: cynic audit secret --json returns zero findings
RUSTFLAGS='-C debuginfo=0' cargo check --workspace passes on builder

action.type: git push mirror to public relay
action.method: fast-forward preferred; archive ref snapshot required before force-push
action.read_back: verify github/ref matches forgejo/ref after push

stages.name: commit_on_forgejo
stages.condition: commit merged into main or release tag created

stages.name: validate_gates
checks: working tree clean and publication contract respected

stages.name: relay_push
stages.read_back: verify github HEAD SHA matches forgejo HEAD SHA

stages.name: relay_complete
stages.evidence: SHA on github matches SHA on forgejo
notes: public projection now reflects sovereign state

exclusions.no_direct_github_commits: GitHub is relay only. No direct commits, PRs, or mutations originate from GitHub.
exclusions.no_force_push_without_reason: Force-push to GitHub relay only for valid release promotion, never arbitrary history rewrite.
exclusions.no_public_secrets: No secrets, credentials, or sensitive data in public projection.

rules.rule: Forgejo is the sovereign source of truth. GitHub is a public relay projection.
notes: Mutations flow downward to GitHub, never upward from GitHub

rules.rule: After relay push, verify that GitHub SHA matches Forgejo SHA.
notes: Read-back proof required for relay completion

rules.rule: No direct commits, PRs, or mutations originate from GitHub.
notes: GitHub receives validated releases and mirrors only
